items.text: Official or co-official languages here: Haryanvi.
English proficiency score 502 (moderate) here, against the national 484 (EF English Proficiency Index 2025).

languages.notes: Signals until the place's own language law and census are read.

laws.rule: Under the Haryana Gauvansh Sanrakshan and Gausamvardhan Act 2015, section 8, no one may sell, keep, store or transport, or offer for sale, beef or beef products in any form, except for prescribed medicinal uses. Beef means the flesh of a cow, including flesh in sealed containers imported into the State; cow includes a bull, bullock, ox, heifer or calf.
laws.penalty_signal: Section 13(3): 3 to 5 years of rigorous imprisonment and a fine of INR 30,000 to 50,000 (about A$447 to A$746). Slaughter (section 3) carries 3 to 10 years and INR 30,000 to 1 lakh (about A$447 to A$1,491).
